'''Baradis''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Prisoners" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he served as a deck officer of ''[[Leveler]]'', under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].<ref name="Prisoners" />
